dialogues.original: Trick or treat! BOO!
Thank you! I'm the spookiest ghost in town!

choices.answer: I believe it! What's under that sheet?
You certainly are! Want some candy?

dialogues.original: Yep! Just cut some holes in an old sheet!

choices.answer: Smart and simple! I like it!

dialogues.original: Uh... yeah! I found it in my... basement!

choices.answer: Your basement? What were you doing down there?

dialogues.original: Under the sheet? Just me! A regular kid! With... arms and legs!

choices.answer: That's oddly specific... How many arms?
Good to know! Here's your treat!

dialogues.original: Yes please! I loooove candy! Especially the salty kind!

choices.answer: Salty? You mean sweet candy, right?

dialogues.original: Thanks! My mom says I'm very creative!

choices.answer: You are! What else have you made?

dialogues.original: Agreed! Plus it's more comfortable than those plastic masks!
Looking for... uh... Halloween decorations! Yeah!

choices.answer: In the basement? Odd place for them...

dialogues.original: Two! Two arms! The normal amount of arms! Definitely not eight!

choices.answer: EIGHT?! Why would you say eight?!

dialogues.original: Uh... yes! Sweet! I meant sweet! I love sweet candy!

choices.answer: Okay then! Here's some sweet candy!

dialogues.original: Yeah! I really like ocean flavors... I mean... CHOCOLATE!
Umm... lots of things! Like... traps! I mean... CRAFTS!
For... floating! I mean walking! Walking around!

choices.answer: Ghosts float, kids walk. Which are you?

dialogues.original: Well... that's where we keep old stuff! Dark... damp... perfect for... storing things!

choices.answer: I guess that makes sense. Here's candy!
You sound TOO comfortable with dark, damp places...

dialogues.original: Just this sheet! And some... tentacles! I MEAN TINSEL!

choices.answer: That's the second weird thing you've said...

dialogues.original: I don't know! It just came out! I'm nervous!

choices.answer: Okay... I'll give you candy this time.

dialogues.original: I was just... thinking about octopuses! They're cool!

choices.answer: TOO convenient! No candy for you!

dialogues.original: I just... really like the ocean! I go to the beach a lot!

choices.answer: Or maybe you LIVE in the ocean!
Beach trips are fun! Here you go!

dialogues.original: NOTHING! Just a normal kid thing! Can I have candy now?!
For... catching fish! I mean... HALLOWEEN! For Halloween!

choices.answer: You keep mentioning ocean stuff! Suspicious!

dialogues.original: I'm a KID! A walking, non-floating kid! Obviously!
